title: What are you good at?
goal_hi: Apni skills aur jo cheez abhi seekh rahe ho, uske baare me batana.

forms.negative: I'm not good at backend yet.
forms.question: What are you good at?

pattern.note_hi: Good at ke baad skill; learning ke baad bhi skill/verb+ing.

examples.hi: Main frontend development me achha hoon.
Main backend development seekh raha hoon.

examples.en: I'm good at fixing responsive design issues.
examples.hi: Main responsive design issues fix karne me achha hoon.
Main SEO aur testing seekh raha hoon.

words.example_hi: Main frontend development par kaam karta hoon.
Main backend development seekh raha hoon.

dialogue.title: Small talk with a colleague
dialogue.context_hi: Office me colleague ke saath skills par halki baat.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What are you working on these days?
lines.hi: Aajkal aap kis cheez par kaam kar rahe ho?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm working on a frontend project, mostly responsive layouts.
lines.hi: Main ek frontend project par kaam kar raha hoon, zyadatar responsive layouts.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Are you good at backend too?
lines.hi: Aap backend me bhi achhe ho?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Not yet. I'm learning backend development now.
lines.hi: Abhi nahi. Main ab backend development seekh raha hoon.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Nice. What else are you learning?
lines.hi: Badhiya. Aur kya seekh rahe ho?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm learning SEO and testing. I also handle website maintenance.
lines.hi: Main SEO aur testing seekh raha hoon. Main website maintenance bhi handle karta hoon.

sound_focus.tip_hi: '-ng' me sound naak se aati hai; 'sin' aur 'sing' alag hain.

scenario.title_hi: Colleague ke saath skills par small talk
scenario.setting_hi: Lunch break me colleague se baat.

turns.hint_hi: Backend aur testing seekh rahe ho.
turns.model_en: I'm learning backend development and software testing.

turns.prompt_en: Who handles SEO at your company?
turns.model_en: I know basic SEO, and my team helps with the rest.
Yes, I handle website maintenance for clients.
